data.title: What Noelle's Clients Say
data.subtitle: Real reviews from Green Light Realty clients.

items.text: Noelle helped us with our dream home and was very knowledgeable and responsive through out the entire process. Navigating the current market was tough but she helped us get through it. Even after we closed she was always available to answer all our questions and help us out
Couldn't be happier to have Noelle as my agent. Thank God she's patient and made it happen. I know I would've given up if I was her, glad she didn't. Noelle made it happen!!!

Noelle was wonderful to work with. She helped my fiancé and I buy our first house. She made the experience easy and enjoyable for first time home buyers like us. Noelle was incredibly helpful throughout the entire process and quick to respond to our many questions: from getting us all of the information on houses we were interested in touring, to recommending a great pizza place by our new home! She was also able to refer us to our lawyer, mortgage broker, and house inspector, all of whom were very professional and great to work with. We are so thankful for hard work and definitely recommend her!
Noelle was a great agent. She walked us through the entire process and pointed out many important key elements to make this transaction a breeze. We will use her services again and again.

Noelle was an absolute blessing from the beginning of our home buying process. Being a first time home buyer I had so many questions and Noelle was so knowledgeable and helpful with everything. She took the time to get to know us personally and really get a feel for what we were looking for and wanted the best for us no matter how long it took or how many homes we looked at. Our home buying process lasted over a year and Noelle was constantly in contact with us with possible winners. I would highly recommend Noelle to anyone looking for a home, she made the whole process enjoyable and fun and we ultimately couldn't be happier with our new home

Noelle was amazing throughout this whole process. She was extremely diligent, working super hard to find us our dream home. This was our first home- Noelle took the time out to walk us through the process, answer all of our questions, and more. She was truly amazing- I would absolutely recommend Noelle!

Noelle was very Nice and Patient with us. We never felt pressured in the selection of right house for our family. She listened and understood our needs and did everything in her power to help us stick to the budget we had in mind. We highly recommend Noelle to anyone out there looking to buy a new home.

Having worked with other agents before, I always felt something was missing. Once I started working with Noelle, I finally figured out why I always felt that way. She went so above and beyond helping my family find the perfect home. Constantly making phone calls for us, diligently checking for listings, and always thinking outside of the box. She is the perfect mix of “get things done” and “kind and respectful”. The beginning of my search for a new home (with a different agent) was filled with anxiety and stress. Once I started working with Noelle, I never felt stressed again. She made the process easy, and fun. I am forever grateful for her, and highly recommended her to anyone looking to buy or sell.

Noelle was wonderful to work with. She is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and thorough. She got to know me as a client, her customer service is more than exceptional. She is very responsive, always on top of things, and even ahead of the lawyers and inspectors, she is on your side. She even reminded me of all the things I needed to do before moving in, insurances, utilities etc. She is honest and dependable and made the whole process stress free and enjoyable. Thank you for finding me my dream retirement home!
